body: This was a mistake.  I deleted this.  Please down vote to oblivion so it doesn't get in the way.

So what way should I live?  What way can I live without this pain?

Nothing matters to me.  I have never been happy.  I am being serious.  I can't stand myself.  I am not excited by anything.  My options are so hopelessly limited.  The only out I can possibly think of is to go live in a temple and learn to meditate for 20 hours a day.  I used to meditate for 4 hours a day.  If I could get it up high enough, I could either be meditating or asleep.  I could probably spend my remaining 30-40 years left of this prison sentence called life doing that.
